 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Compare the vertical run lengths of each non-background color on
    # either side of the horizontal 5 separator; select the color with the
    # larger top/bottom difference and encode it as a 2x2 block.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)})
    def count(part, color):
        return sum(v == color for row in part for v in row)
    chosen = max(colors, key=lambda c: abs(count(top, c) - count(bottom, c)))
    return [[chosen, chosen], [chosen, chosen]]
"
}
